inputs.text: An Indiana judge has blocked a pro-life law after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice claimed abortion restrictions violate religious freedom. That turns a constitutional safeguard into a weapon against society’s duty to protect unborn life. Courts should not recast abortion access as a religious entitlement and put individual claims above the vulnerable.
